meta.title: Maqsad: your journey abroad, with more transparency
meta.description: Maqsad connects students and job seekers with education and recruitment agents, with verification, clear fee records and document checks before anyone pays.

footer.disclaimer: Maqsad flags risks. It cannot prove that a document, person, agent or opportunity is genuine or safe. Always confirm with the issuer through contact details you find on their official website, never the ones in a document.
footer.notPayments: Maqsad does not handle or hold money.

documentCheck.title: Document checks
documentCheck.body: Check an offer letter, visa letter, job offer or agent message against official registers and sources, with the evidence for every finding.

accounts.title: Student and agent accounts
accounts.body: Register as a student or an agent, sign in and manage your account.

studentProfile.title: Student profiles
studentProfile.body: Your education, qualifications, goals and destination preferences in one place.

profileVisibility.title: You control who sees you
profileVisibility.body: Agents only see your profile if you choose to appear in discovery.

agentDirectory.body: Browse agents by destination and service, with their disclosed fees and verification status.

agentProfile.title: Agent and agency profiles
agentProfile.body: Business details, services, specialisations and disclosed fees.

credentialSubmission.title: Credential verification
credentialSubmission.body: Submit licences and registrations for review. The status you see is the real review status.

studentDiscovery.title: Student discovery
studentDiscovery.body: Find students who have chosen to be visible, filtered by destination, level and field.

matching.title: Matching with reasons
matching.body: Suggested matches explain why they were suggested. A match is never a guarantee of admission or a job.

connections.title: Connection requests
connections.body: An agent asks to connect; the student accepts or declines. Nothing is shared before that.

messaging.title: Messages
messaging.body: Talk to connected students or agents inside Maqsad, with a history both sides can see.

caseTracking.title: Application tracking
caseTracking.body: Requirements, documents, deadlines and milestones for each application, showing who updated what and when.

feeRecords.title: Fee and commitment records
feeRecords.body: Record agreed fees, promises and payment status. A recorded payment is what a party reported, not proof of a transfer.

savedReports.title: Saved verification reports
savedReports.body: Keep your reports with each application and come back to them later.

complaints.title: Reports and disputes
complaints.body: Report suspicious behaviour or raise a dispute linked to the application it concerns.

planLimits.title: Plan limits
planLimits.body: Report limits and plan features applied to your account.

adminReview.title: Human review
adminReview.body: Maqsad staff review credentials, reports and disputes.

auditLog.title: Activity history
auditLog.body: A record of important account and case activity.

deepfakeDetection.title: Deepfake detection
deepfakeDetection.body: Planned. Maqsad does not check images or video for manipulation today, and will not show results until a tested detector exists.

home.title: Your journey abroad, with greater transparency, verification and accountability
home.intro: Maqsad connects students and job seekers with overseas education and recruitment agents. Check documents before you pay, see who you are dealing with, and keep a clear record of what was agreed.
home.buildingIntro: Maqsad is being built in stages. Each feature says whether you can use it today.
home.never1: Say a document, agent or opportunity is completely genuine or safe.
home.never2: Mark an agent as verified because they pay for a subscription.
home.never3: Read your Gmail, WhatsApp or other accounts. We only check what you choose to submit.
home.never4: Handle, hold or transfer your money.

howItWorks.title: How Maqsad works
howItWorks.intro: Students and agents connect only when the student agrees, then track the application together.
howItWorks.step2: The student chooses whether agents can find them.
howItWorks.step3: Agents find visible students or get matching suggestions.
howItWorks.step4: An agent sends a connection request.
howItWorks.step6: Once connected, they message and manage the application on Maqsad.
howItWorks.step7: Both sides track fees, documents, deadlines and progress.
howItWorks.checkBody: Anyone can check an offer letter, visa letter, job offer or agent message today. The report shows what was checked, which source supports each finding and what could not be verified.

students.title: For students and job seekers
students.intro: Know more about an agent and an offer before you share documents or pay anything.
students.free: The free student plan includes a set number of verification reports each month.

agents.title: For education and recruitment agents
agents.intro: Show students your credentials and fees up front, and keep a clear record of every application.
agents.paidNotVerified: A paid plan gives you features. It never changes your verification status, which only comes from a completed review.

trust.title: Verification and trust
trust.intro: How Maqsad checks things, and what it does not claim.
trust.now1: Payment channels: JazzCash, Easypaisa, money transfer services and crypto
trust.now2: Whether the payee matches the issuer
trust.now3: Free email senders and email domains that differ from the website
trust.now4: CAS, DLI, CRICOS and SEVIS number formats
trust.now5: Domain age, PDF producer and edit dates
trust.now6: Live student visa registers: UK sponsor register, Canada's DLI list and Australia's CRICOS
trust.now7: Web research for official sites, approved agent lists and scam reports
trust.finding2: What evidence was available, quoted where possible
trust.finding5: Why a warning was raised and what to do next
trust.failBody: If a source is down or a check cannot run, the report says the information could not be verified. A failed check is never treated as proof of fraud, and the result becomes "checks incomplete" rather than "no red flags".
trust.scoreBody: The risk level is calculated in code from the red flags found. An AI model can add a red flag but can never remove one, so text hidden in a document cannot lower the risk.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Plans give access to features. Paying never makes an account verified.
pricing.teamSoon: Team management for agencies is planned.
pricing.limitsNote: Plan limits apply once accounts are linked to verification reports. Until then, the public document check is free.
pricing.betaNote: No payments are taken yet. When paid plans open, you will be able to request an upgrade from your dashboard.

auth.confirmEmail: Check your email for a link to confirm your account, then log in.
auth.consent: By creating an account you agree that Maqsad stores your name, email and role to run your account. Nothing is shown to other users until you choose to share it.

checker.title: Check a document before you pay anyone
checker.intro: Upload a university offer, scholarship or job offer, visa letter, degree, or paste an agent's WhatsApp message. We check it against official registers and sources and show you the evidence.
checker.choose: Choose a PDF or photo, or drop it here
checker.fileHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 4 MB
checker.messagePlaceholder: Paste the WhatsApp message or email here, including the sender's number or email address.
checker.privacy: Your document is sent to Google Gemini and Groq for analysis. We don't store it.
checker.tooBig: This file is larger than 4 MB. Take a smaller photo or a screenshot of the letter.
checker.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
checker.progressHint: This usually takes under a minute.
checker.extracted: What we read from the document
checker.summaryNote: Report findings and summaries are written in English, with an Urdu summary.

medium.title: Some concerns
medium.advice: Verify with the issuer before paying.

low.title: No red flags found
low.advice: Still confirm with the issuer before paying.

incomplete.title: Checks incomplete
incomplete.advice: Confirm with the issuer before paying.

contact.title: Confirm directly with the issuer
contact.source: Found on the official website, not copied from your document.
contact.none: We couldn't find an official contact. Search for the institution's website yourself and use the contact details there, not the ones in the document.

checks.title: What we check
checks.doc1: How you are asked to pay: JazzCash, Easypaisa, money transfer services or crypto
checks.doc2: Whether the money goes to the issuer or to someone else
checks.doc3: Gmail senders, and email domains that don't match the website
checks.doc4: CAS, DLI, CRICOS and SEVIS number formats
checks.doc5: Short deadlines, threats, and hidden text aimed at AI checkers
checks.doc6: Which tool made the PDF and when it was last edited
checks.src1: How long the website's domain has existed
checks.src2: Student visa registers: the UK sponsor register, Canada's DLI list and Australia's CRICOS
checks.src3: Official websites, HEC, the Bureau of Emigration and approved agent lists
checks.never: We never say a document is genuine. The best result is "no red flags found", with an official contact to confirm it.
